notes.subject: ותטעם / ותשלחם
notes.rationale: Safiks -ם i min ol lain bilong Isrel (BSB: 'our fathers') o ol olman lain yet (YLT)? Mipela makim ol lain bilong Yahwe.

notes.subject: הורשת
notes.rationale: יורש em i 'rausim ol i stap bipo na holim graun', mipla ridim 'rausim' tasol.

notes.subject: ותטעם ... ותשלחם
notes.rationale: Planim na salim i go — tupela tok i daunim narapela; plant vs send away pasel i no kamap klaus long Tok Pisin.

translation: Yu, wantaim ⟨את⟩ han bilong yu yu rausim ol olman lain, na yu planim ⟨ol lain bilong yu⟩; yu bagarapim ol lain manmeri, na yu salim ol ⟨i⟩ go.

tokens.gloss: na yu salim ol i go
